scenario: Your hidden cultivation progress may be exposed at an upcoming clan review

attack.failure_mode: Clan enforcers detect resource diversion through accounting discrepancies and initiate a soul-searching ritual
attack.worst_case: True cultivation level exposed, leading to immediate execution for deception with no chance to fabricate breakthrough story

refined.name: Shadowed Accumulation
refined.action: Donate valuable but common resources with legitimate accounting trails
refined.resource_move: Divert resources to secret cultivation through third-party intermediaries
refined.info_gain: Observe clan members' reactions and verify accounting oversight
refined.exit_plan: Fabricate breakthrough story with corroborating evidence
refined.patched_failure_mode: Accounting discrepancies masked through legitimate trails and intermediaries

gen.name: Information Obfuscation Through Controlled Disclosure
gen.action: Strategically leak cultivation evidence at varying levels to different factions
gen.resource_move: Divide cultivation resources into visible and hidden pools
gen.info_gain: Monitor reactions to gauge rival knowledge levels
gen.concealment: Keep actual core cultivation level completely masked
gen.exit_plan: Deny all claims if exposed, shift blame to external sources

attack.failure_mode: Controlled disclosure backfires when a rival faction discovers the pattern of intentional leaks, leading to them manipulating the information environment to expose the true cultivation level
attack.worst_case: A sophisticated rival faction orchestrates a cascade of false information that makes the agent's cultivation appear both higher and lower simultaneously, creating an information crisis that leads to a joint coalition of multiple factions attacking the agent under suspicion of hiding a breakthrough cultivation level, resulting in the complete destruction of the agent's resources and cultivation base

refined.name: Information Obfuscation Through Controlled Disclosure
refined.action: Strategically leak cultivation evidence at varying levels to different factions with embedded verification markers
refined.resource_move: Divide cultivation resources into visible and hidden pools, with decoy resources specifically designed to appear as leaks
refined.info_gain: Monitor reactions to gauge rival knowledge levels, cross-check against planted decoy information
refined.concealment: Keep actual core cultivation level completely masked, with multiple false cultivation signatures
refined.exit_plan: Deny all claims if exposed, shift blame to external sources, reveal planted decoy evidence as proof of manipulation
refined.patched_failure_mode: Pattern recognition is mitigated by embedding verification markers in leaks and planting decoy information that appears authentic but can be disavowed if detected

attack.failure_mode: False trails lead rival cultivators to your actual cultivation resources through reverse engineering
attack.worst_case: Rivals discover your true cultivation progress, steal your resources, and frame you for cultivation theft, leading to clan execution

refined.name: Strategic Obfuscation
refined.action: Plant false cultivation trails with decoy resources
refined.resource_move: Divert resources to misdirection with verification checkpoints
refined.exit_plan: Blame external interference with evidence trail
refined.patched_failure_mode: Decoy resources and verification checkpoints prevent reverse engineering to true cultivation resources

selection_note: ALL candidates survival-threatened: least-doomed fallback (lowest effective threat probability), mirroring the compiler's doomed-path TERMINAL acceptance
rationale_2sentences: Misdirection creates plausible deniability while maintaining cultivation integrity. External interference provides an escape route if exposure occurs.
external_message: External forces seek to undermine our progress. We remain vigilant against false claims.
